notes.title: Are you ready to run, guys?
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30173462/80250689536fac975af7e3388702a2821a3d030d.png

We're so excited that Runaway VR will be released already tomorrow! (August 4)

So today you have a chance to play this awesome game with us on our Twitch channel https://www.twitch.tv/panoramikinc

Don't miss the translaton! We start at 17:00 (GMT+0)!

Press release: http://mailchi.mp/57eef408e7b2/runaway-vr-steam-release-209287
